name: Ben McAdams
summary: Benjamin Michael McAdams (born December 5, 1974) is an American politician and attorney who is the United States representative-elect from Utah's 1st congressional district. He previously served as the U.S. representative from Utah's 4th congressional district from 2019 to 2021. McAdams will return to the House on January 3, 2027, this time representing Utah's 1st congressional district, after winning the 2026 election over Republican nominee Riley Owen.
